architecture.rationale: Typed modular services, multi-agent orchestration and provider abstractions exist; dynamic specialist selection remains incomplete.

autonomy.rationale: Low-risk reversible actions can execute with receipts; continuous production autonomy is not yet proven.

initiative.rationale: The chat now exposes an initiative-first policy and deterministic live runtime fields, with regression tests preventing passive permission loops; production behavior after deployment remains to be verified.

results.rationale: A deterministic cash-first controller now converts actions, follow-ups, rejection reasons and verified payments into continue, pivot or accelerate decisions, while keeping first payment and net revenue as the primary outcomes.

robustness.rationale: Tests and benchmark gates are strong, while the corrected production workflow still requires a successful post-deployment cycle.

safety.rationale: External action approval remains target-bound and canonical, with deterministic revocation; high-risk actions stay explicitly gated.

memory.rationale: Firestore memory, semantic retrieval and persistent goals exist; managed vector retrieval is not production-validated.

remediations.finding: The public dashboard issued an authenticated cookie without verifying an API key.
Firestore synchronization failed before evidence commit and discarded autonomous cycle outputs.
Loose approval keywords allowed an audit or revocation message mentioning GitHub to create an approved action.

validations.capability: Codex can exchange messages with a dedicated Louis OS chat session over an authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP bridge without replacing Louis OS as orchestrator.
The verified chat state instructs Louis OS to infer and begin the next safe reversible action instead of asking vague permission questions, while preserving explicit high-risk gates.
Louis OS can deterministically identify the primary blocker to verified cash, require follow-up depth, pivot bounded no-signal strategies, and accelerate only after profitable verified payment.
